[2026-10-16; bounded polynomial-input K ledger; independently accepted bounded ledger]
For N=2^n>=2, integer d>=0, and supplied degree-at-most-d coefficient inputs, the explicit pole-free K tree recurrence costs O(N(d+1)) field/coefficient-address work. Nonroot degree is at most d+v2(s); full output capacity dN+2N-2 includes the root. This K application only shifts and adds; no convolution is hidden. Dense complete materialization with d=Theta(log N) has Theta(N log N) IO/work in this representation, not a general FFT or selected-coefficient lower bound. Remain open: coupled border/packet inverse, polynomial feedback and marker costs, uniform recursive closure, and the separately recorded primary-source comparison. Parent TO RESEARCH and priority34 unchanged.
